body:
Part of track #51. Decisions settled here.

## What
- Lead with the adopter's 3-command quickstart (`npx hkb init` → `npx hkb doctor --api` → `npx hkb dispatch --loop 60`), then npm-version + CI badges, then a ~10-line "how it works" (issues are cards, deps are edges, refs are locks, any harness is a worker).
- Move this repo's self-hosting narrative and verified-API-facts detail into `docs/` (linked), keeping README pointed at someone who has never seen the project.
- Keep the philosophy bullets (free board, deterministic dispatcher, zero deps) — they are the pitch.

## Done when
A stranger can go from zero to a dispatched worker using README alone; links intact; lint/test green (README examples that claim commands exist must be real).
title: README for an adopter, not for us
